entries.name: Dr. Čupona Veterinary Clinic
entries.duty: Urgent cases and on-call vet open 24/7. Regular hours Mon-Fri 10:00-14:00 and 17:00-19:00, Sat 10:00-14:00, Sun closed.

duty_i18n.sl: Nujni primeri in dežurni veterinar 24 ur na dan. Redni delovni čas pon–pet 10–14 in 17–19, sob 10–14, ob nedeljah zaprto.
duty_i18n.hr: Hitni slučajevi i dežurni veterinar dostupni 24/7. Redovno radno vrijeme pon–pet 10:00–14:00 i 17:00–19:00, sub 10:00–14:00, ned zatvoreno.
duty_i18n.de: Notfälle und diensthabender Tierarzt rund um die Uhr erreichbar. Reguläre Öffnungszeiten Mo–Fr 10–14 und 17–19 Uhr, Sa 10–14 Uhr, So geschlossen.
duty_i18n.fr: Cas urgents et vétérinaire de garde 24 h/24, 7 j/7. Horaires habituels lun.–ven. 10 h–14 h et 17 h–19 h, sam. 10 h–14 h, fermé le dimanche.
duty_i18n.es: Casos urgentes y veterinario de guardia abiertos 24/7. Horario habitual lun–vie 10:00–14:00 y 17:00–19:00 h, sáb 10:00–14:00 h, cerrado dom.

entries.note: Own page quotes: "Ургентна услуга и дежурен ветеринар 24/7" and "За ургентни случаеви:Отворено 24/7". Page itself has no address; address from FVA microchipping list (row 12, Др. Чупона, Бошко Најдовски бр. 44) and pets.mk directory.

entries.name: Veterinaren Centar

duty_i18n.de: Mo–Fr 8–20 Uhr, Sa 9–14 Uhr, So 10–14 Uhr.
duty_i18n.fr: Lun.–ven. 8 h–20 h, sam. 9 h–14 h, dim. 10 h–14 h.

entries.note: Own contact page heading says open every day except Sunday but lists Sunday 10:00-14:00 (conflict). No 24h/emergency statement. Phone as on own page.

entries.name: Mano Pet & Vet

duty_i18n.sl: pon–pet 8–19, sob 8–15. Na telefon 070 722 967 se oglasijo 9–19.
duty_i18n.de: Mo–Fr 8–19 Uhr, Sa 8–15 Uhr. Telefon 070 722 967, besetzt 9–19 Uhr.
duty_i18n.fr: Lun.–ven. 8 h–19 h, sam. 8 h–15 h. Téléphone 070 722 967, joignable 9 h–19 h.

entries.note: No emergency statement; "24-hour veterinary supervision" on /za-nas/ refers to boarding only. Second phone +389 75 841 284.

entries.name: Remedium Vet

duty_i18n.de: Mo–Fr 8–18 Uhr, Sa 9–16 Uhr, So geschlossen.
duty_i18n.fr: Lun.–ven. 8 h–18 h, sam. 9 h–16 h, fermé le dimanche.
duty_i18n.es: Lun–vie 8:00–18:00 h, sáb 9:00–16:00 h, cerrado dom.

entries.note: Own page says urgent cases are seen but gives no emergency hours; FAQ on emergency service is placeholder text. Not 24h.

entries.name: Pet Vet Aerodrom
entries.address: bul. Jane Sandanski 61 (towers behind Capitol Mall), Skopje
entries.note: Own page has no hours or 24h statement; FAQ only advises contacting a vet in emergencies. Hours Mon-Fri 10-18, Sat 10-13 appear only on zk.mk directory (not used).

entries.name: University Veterinary Hospital (Faculty of Veterinary Medicine)
entries.note: University page gives address and extension 3240-785 (main faculty number +389 2 3240 700), email uvb@fvm.ukim.edu.mk. No hours or 24h/emergency statement on FVM pages; ICU only described as "continuous surveillance". FVA list row 101 also gives 02/3240-785.

entries.name: Veterinarna bolnica Skopje
entries.duty: Separate duty line may exist; call ahead.

duty_i18n.sl: Morda obstaja ločena dežurna številka; vnaprej pokličite.
duty_i18n.hr: Možda postoji zasebna dežurna linija; nazovi unaprijed.
duty_i18n.de: Eventuell separate Notdienstnummer; bitte vorher anrufen.
duty_i18n.fr: Une ligne de garde distincte existe peut-être ; appelez avant de venir.
duty_i18n.es: Puede haber una línea de guardia aparte; llama antes.

entries.note: FVA row 87: 02/3115-756; 075/404-200. Own site (incl. /dezurna-sluzba "Дежурна служба" page) blocked by robots.txt, so not read; zk.mk directory lists "Ветеринарна болница - дежурна служба" Lazar Pop Trajkov 5/8, 075 404 221 / 075 404 222 with no hours and no 24h statement (aggregator, not used). Needs manual check of /dezurna-sluzba; emergency_24h left false.

notes: Only 1 explicit 24/7 clinic found (Dr. Čupona, Bitola). No official duty rota and no animal poison line found. Blocked by robots.txt / unreadable: Macedonian Veterinary Chamber (mvk.org.mk), veterinarnabolnica.com.mk (incl. /dezurna-sluzba, likely duty page - check manually), happypet.mk, cityvet.mk, dogcat.mk, zoovet.com.mk; vetsvet.mk loops on a 302 redirect; inovet.mk under construction; fvu.gov.mk/fva.gov.mk registry pages not fetchable (FVA PDFs used). Facebook pages not readable. Aggregators (zk.mk, pets.mk, abv.mk, wordpress reposts) were read only to find names and never used as the basis for 24h or hours. FVA-only entries have unverified, possibly stale phone/address. Not covered: 24h search in Tetovo, Kumanovo, Štip, Strumica, Veles, Prilep, Ohrid found nothing on own pages. Human poison centre does not count as animal poison line. Follow-up run 2026-11-04 (Skopje/Ohrid/Tetovo/Kumanovo, Skopje Veterinary Hospital duty hours): no new entries added. WebSearch returned almost no Macedonian clinic sites, and own-site URLs could not be opened (not discoverable). Skopje Veterinary Hospital (Lazar Pop Trajkov 5/8) duty hours NOT found: veterinarnabolnica.com.mk not reachable again; aggregator zk.mk lists duty phones +389 75 404221 / +389 75 404222 but no hours and no 24h claim (not used as a basis). Other names seen only on aggregators (no phone/own site, so not added): Ultravet (Gemidzhiska 123-a, Skopje). Kajak.mk 'Pet hotel Brvenica, Tetovo' is a pet hotel attached to an unnamed vet clinic, not a clinic listing. Yo Pet Clinic Skopje page (yopetclinic.com) looks like a non-local template site (Indian WhatsApp number) - ignored. Facebook (Drachevo Vet) robots-blocked. Still no 24h clinic found in Ohrid, Tetovo, Kumanovo.
